
# The rules of termination across modules by default, by use (https://github.com/erniecohen/dafny/issues/211): without --modular-termination, a program with a global or callback bound, a {:termination_closed} promise or an unmarked extension of a trait of another module is checked by the rules of revision 3; one without is translated as before; a legacy form on the edge that crosses modules covers the types below it, as in 4.11; the hidden --legacy-no-modular-termination restores the rules of 4.11, and a library built under one setting is refused under the other. traits/TraitMultiModule.dfy keeps its 4.11 errors under the hidden option.
git-issues/github-issue-211-xmod.dfy
